title: Ethical Reasoning
summary: Examining what ought to be done by making values, affected parties, duties, consequences, rights, and trade-offs explicit.
definition: Ethical reasoning compares defensible principles and perspectives in context. It does not reduce value conflicts to technical optimization; it makes assumptions and consequences open to deliberation.
learning_outcomes: Identify stakeholders and who may benefit or bear risk.
Distinguish empirical claims from value judgments.
Compare options using explicit principles and explain unresolved trade-offs.
